summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the redesigned Landing page (Iteration 7). ALL TESTS PASSED - Landing page loads correctly with all sections, navigation, RTL support, and FloatingChat widget working as expected. The new design follows 'Pastel & Soft / Swiss Clean' guidelines with flat cards, violet/indigo gradients, rounded-3xl corners, and generous spacing.
passed_tests: Landing page loads without errors at root URL /
Navigation bar renders with logo (Letsm AI), links (Features, Demo, Pricing, Privacy, Sign In), language toggle globe icon, and 'Get Started' CTA button

Hero section shows 'Your Life, Simplified' heading with violet gradient text, subtitle, 'Get Started Free' and 'Try Demo' buttons, 4 feature pills (Natural Language, Smart Scheduling, Context-Aware, Privacy-First), and hero mockup image with floating badges
Features section (id='features') shows 'Powerful Features' title with 6 feature cards in a 3-column grid (data-testid='feature-card-0' through 'feature-card-5')
Advanced Features section shows 'Enhanced Intelligence' title with 6 cards

Live Demo section (id='demo') shows 'See It In Action' title, chat interface mockup on left and 3 scenario buttons on right (data-testid='demo-scenario-0/1/2'). Clicking a scenario button animates messages in the chat with action badge
Real Conversations section shows 4 conversation cards in a 2-column grid (data-testid='conversations-grid') with chat bubbles and green action badges

Integrations section (data-testid='integrations-section') shows 2 cards (Messaging and Calendar) with platform items (WhatsApp, Telegram, Web Chat, Slack, Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar, Microsoft 365) and 'Soon' badges
Testimonials section (data-testid='testimonials-grid') shows 6 testimonial cards with gradient avatar initials

Privacy section (id='privacy') shows 'Your Privacy, Our Priority' title, 6 privacy feature cards (data-testid='privacy-features'), commitment list with privacy illustration image, and amber Safety Guidelines box
Pricing section (id='pricing') shows 3 plans (Free/$0, Pro/$9.99, Business/$29.99) with the Pro plan highlighted in violet with 'Most Popular' badge (data-testid='pricing-plan-0/1/2')
FAQ accordion (data-testid='faq-section') toggles open/close on click (data-testid='faq-0' through 'faq-3')
CTA section shows 'Ready to Simplify Your Life?' with stats (50K+, 2M+, 99.9%)
Footer renders with logo, links (Privacy, Terms, Support, Contact), and copyright '2026 Letsm AI'

FloatingChat widget (data-testid='floating-chat-button') appears in bottom-right corner, opens chat window (data-testid='floating-chat-window'), accepts input (data-testid='floating-chat-input'), sends messages (data-testid='floating-chat-send'), and closes (data-testid='close-chat-button')
Navigation anchor links (#features, #demo, #pricing, #privacy) scroll to correct sections
Get Started and Sign In links navigate to /login route
RTL support: Language toggle button switches to Arabic layout with dir='rtl' and all text in Arabic
